Gifsicle 1.95 — license and credits
====================================

This directory contains an unmodified official Gifsicle 1.95 Windows binary
downloaded from https://www.lcdf.org/gifsicle/.

Copyright (C) 1997-2025 Eddie Kohler.
Distributed under the GNU General Public License, Version 2 (and only
Version 2). The full license text is in COPYING-GPLv2.txt in this directory.

Corresponding source code: https://github.com/kohler/gifsicle (tag v1.95)

Note on licensing
-----------------
GIF Maker Pro+ invokes Gifsicle as a separate process; it does not link to
or embed Gifsicle source code. Therefore the GPL applies only to this
bundled binary, not to the rest of this repository (which is MIT-licensed).
